mapper.select: SELECT om.MODEL AS model, gen.BUILD_WEEK AS builtWeek, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP AS customerAdap, gen.PRODUCT_TYPE AS productType, om.VIN AS vin, gen.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION AS countryOfOperation, var.FAMILY_ID AS familyId, var.VARIANT_ID AS variantId FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL gen ON om.SERIE = gen.SERIE AND om.CHNR = gen.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_VARIANTS var ON om.SERIE = var.SERIE AND om.CHNR = var.CHNR WHERE om.SERIE = #{serie} AND om.CHNR = #{chnr}
